label: A first unmoved mover first in being is first in PRIOR_1: none other is PRIOR_1 to it
paraphrase: OPEN sense bridge PRIOR_4 to PRIOR_1, analyst formulation, attribution deferred: for every f, if f is a first mover moved by none and nothing other than f is prior to it in being (PRIOR_4), then nothing other than f is prior to it in act in a respect (PRIOR_1, the PriorSimply of DEF-SIMPLE-PRIORITY): every y with PriorSimply y f is f. It is restricted to first unmoved movers that are first in being and is not a general inclusion of PRIOR_1 in PRIOR_4. A general inclusion would be excluded, by an unchecked one-step composition, from the sense-mixing control of this batch, 6ca87431 and an admitted reciprocal cross-respect moving case. It is a sufficient bridge for the pure-act derivation of this batch; a respect-matched weaker variant (only a being in act in a respect in which f is in potency and PRIOR_1 to f must be f) also suffices (checked controls RespectMatchedFirstInBeingBridge and pureActOfRespectMatchedBridge in the vocabulary module). Given the PRIOR_4 sibling c51a07a1 (every first unmoved mover is first in being), the bridge is equivalent to the content of 74eb9113 (checked control firstInActBridge_iff_firstBeing); with an empty CanBeWithout c51a07a1 holds trivially, and on DEF-CAN-BE-WITHOUT's real-possibility reading nothing is PRIOR_4 to a necessarily existing f, so for the classical first mover the bridge just is 74eb9113. The split route therefore gives no new warrant for PRIOR_1-firstness; its gain is sense hygiene. Strongest positive warrant on file: In V Metaph. lect. 13 n. 18, 'omnia priora aliquo modo possunt esse sine posterioribus', which reduces priority by act and potency (n. 17) to being-without 'aliquo modo'; the qualifier suggests that a single unindexed CanBeWithout is too coarse to carry that reduction. Lane B's 2026-11-18 second test named this crux: 'nothing other than the first being is prior to it in act in any respect'. Rival on file: the firstWayDoesNotYieldPureAct model of result afd52425, where a first unmoved mover f is in potency to a respect in which it moves nothing and another being, in act in that respect, is PRIOR_1 to f; there the bridge holds only if some other being is PRIOR_4 to f, so together with c51a07a1 it excludes the model.
